candidate_identity: Working candidate bytes listed below; not yet a new committed or executed product qualification.
decision: No blocking source defect found in the reviewed lifecycle slice. Suitable for fixed-source complete build/runtime acceptance; this receipt does not approve an unexecuted product or enable new HOS2 operations.

resolved_design_findings.evidence: with_initial_image takes Process VMAR -> TaskSet -> image. Process::run and accepted exec/exit use TaskSet -> image. Image methods acquire no outer lock. Existing procfs VMAR -> main_thread/TaskSet remains unchanged.

PreparedInitialProcess is private and non-Clone, constructed only after create_init_task succeeds. The same VmarHandle is moved into PosixThreadBuilder; token retains the matching Arc<Vmar>, Arc<Task> and Arc<Process>. with_initial_image checks Process VMAR, exact sole main Task, Task weak Process backlink and live TaskSet. FirstRun is canonical under the image lock; both prepared and ordinary Process start claim it before enqueue.

session and check_session reject Closing/Closed. begin_close cannot reopen Closed; close is idempotent. commit_exec accepts only Closing, closes before checked epoch increment, clears nonce only for a new successful epoch and preserves first_run. Nonce allocator and epoch overflow are checked and terminal.

Device still advertises QueryAbi only, max response payload 48 and no features. All four recognized resource operations remain EOPNOTSUPP; no resource grant, handle table, delivery table or budget ledger was introduced.

reviewed_call_paths.property: Failed exec before acceptance preserves the image
reviewed_call_paths.reasoning: sys_execve first resolves/opens the supplied path. do_execve then reads argv/envp, resolves program/credentials and fully loads a new VMAR before TaskSet.start_execve. Every ? before that point leaves the old image state untouched. Existing EAGAIN when another exec/exit already owns TaskSet does not close a separate live image.

reviewed_call_paths.property: Irreversible exec closes before sibling signalling
reviewed_call_paths.reasoning: Immediately after start_execve, begin_hepta_image_close runs under TaskSet before sigkill_other_threads. Success through do_execve_no_return is required for commit_hepta_exec_image; any failure or overflow closes before enqueuing SIGKILL. No failed path runs commit-new-image after close.

Accepted exit_group sets the group flag and closes image admission before sibling signalling. A non-last ordinary exit does not close. remove_exited=true closes under TaskSet before dropping files/thread VMAR; exit_process completes Closed before Process VMAR removal. Actual syscall body was reviewed; current unit fixtures do not execute a last-thread exit syscall.

reviewed_call_paths.property: Ordinary fork first-run expect is an internal invariant
reviewed_call_paths.reasoning: Current only production Process::run call is clone_child after a fresh Process::new, sole Task insertion, cgroup assignment and membership-lock release. The new Task has not run. Merely publishing the PID and allowing signals does not execute that Task or mutate its Process first_run/exec/exit lifecycle. Prepared init uses a separate consuming path. Running, prepared or closed Process cannot silently enqueue through Process::run.

reviewed_call_paths.property: Prepared validation and failure do not publish an orphan
reviewed_call_paths.reasoning: resume consumes/validates before bootstrap PID/session registration. No fallible preparation remains after registration. Failure consumes self and Drop cancels only the matching still-prepared key. Success sets consumed=true and Started before enqueue. All process locks are released before registration or Task.run.

Exact Process allocation is checked through the Task Weak backlink; Task is the sole main member, not exited; Process retains the exact VMAR Arc. Private create_init passed that same VmarHandle into create_init_task and builder. The unstarted Task ThreadLocal is not arbitrarily inspected: same-VMAR Task origin is proved by this restricted factory call path. An Arc<Vmar> pin is used, not an extra VmarHandle.

No new image method acquires CPU membership/runqueue/bandwidth locks, drops a CpuCgroupLease, resets cumulative/debt/revision or substitutes a new owner. Original CpuCgroupLease, clone membership handling, native CPU state and scheduler source bytes are unchanged. test_util extends actual unstarted Task construction; its temporary VmarHandle is dropped on return, leaving one handle per created Task.

reviewed_call_paths.property: Device retains exact Process and complete image key
reviewed_call_paths.reasoning: Per-open file stores Weak<Process> and ProcessImageKey. check_session retains Arc equality before phase/epoch/nonce validation on the canonical image lock. Passing an fd or sharing credentials is not authority. The check still precedes user copies; admitted QueryAbi-only requests can finish without resource effects. Future resource operations require post-copy canonical owner admission.

guest_source_review.status: source reviewed; no guest executed by this reviewer
cases: SYS_execve valid probe pathname with argv pointer 1 strictly requires EFAULT; original and fresh fds keep complete boot/space identity.
SYS_execve nonexistent pathname strictly requires ENOENT; original and fresh fds retain identity.
pthread worker checks same PID and distinct TID; shared old fd and fresh open match full 16-byte boot and CapSpace.
pthread_join provides completion synchronization; surviving main fd and fresh open remain valid after non-last exit.
Original successful exec child and original source remain unchanged, with candidate early-return preventing repeated added markers.
Runner requires all old markers plus four lifecycle and four disabled-operation markers exactly once and in the applicable order; final process and QEMU checks remain.
limits: EFAULT and ENOENT cover pre-boundary failures, not fatal post-boundary exec.

New guest cases also pass the old QueryAbi implementation and are compatibility/non-regression checks; actual new lifecycle state logic must be exercised by the new kernel cases and new product build.
Guest non-last-thread survival is observable; no successful ioctl after final Process exit is claimed.

kernel_test_scope: 18 newly declared ktests, nine image-state and nine prepared-init. They allocate actual Process/Task/VMAR objects, invoke production lifecycle methods and mutate boundary setup in tests. No fixture Task is scheduled and no fixture executable is loaded. The prepared_old_epoch test deliberately simulates a lifecycle replacement on an unstarted fixture; it is not real exec evidence.
